description: This Java class 'SimpleMapProcess' handles a sequence of string operations on a specified field, including reading operation configurations from XML, executing operations, and managing associated data structures.

classes.name: SimpleMapProcess
classes.description: Main class for processing a sequence of string operations on a specific field, configurable via XML.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes all configured string operations on the input map, producing results and messages.

methods.name: getFieldName
methods.description: Returns the name of the field this process operates on.

methods.name: readOperations
methods.description: Reads and initializes operation objects from XML configuration elements.
